verdict.rationale: Apple's Mac Help index lists a first-party 'Tile app windows' topic, so macOS has native window tiling. The evidence is only a table-of-contents mention, with no detail on snapping behavior or predefined layouts. Community tips about Option-double-click edge filling and third-party tools like Moom are adjacent or workarounds and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented snap-to-edge behavior, a set of predefined multi-window layouts, keyboard or menu controls for tiling, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snap and tile windows into predefined layouts for multitasking
